data.title: 椎叶紬 · 借来的伞
data.description: 雨来得突然，紬站在屋檐下整理刚借到的伞。她伸手试了试雨势，确认伞面撑开后才准备出发。
data.action: 她伸手试了试雨势，确认伞面撑开后才准备出发
data.promptProse: Stepping out from beneath a striped shop awning, Tsumugi holds a yellow umbrella and tilts her head upward with a gentle smile as the rain subsides. Daylight reflects off street puddles and colorful floral displays outside the storefront.
data.animaCaption: Stepping out from under the striped storefront awning, she raises a bright yellow umbrella and tilts her face upward with a gentle smile to check the easing rain. Soft overcast daylight reflects in puddles across the wet pavement.
